statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail is in the watch band while Stress remains extreme.
recommendation: Tail remains below the 25% block threshold; the principal conditional risk window is the U.S. cash open through the early Fed-speaker sequence.
headline: Technology strength persists, while current Tail remains below the block threshold
body: Asian technology shares extended Monday's U.S. AI-led advance and fresh reporting showed supportive risk appetite. A delayed NQ quote was positive and below its overnight high, but granular pullback and extension evidence was insufficient to establish persistent mean-reversion failure. Event density rises at the U.S. cash open and the 14:00 UTC speaker cluster.

lookbackSummary: Tail rose from low/watch early on September 21 to a 38% high at 19:00 UTC during the technology-led U.S. advance, then fell sharply through the close and maintenance sequence. The four latest published hours returned to 18-19% low Tail.
outlookSummary: Overnight and European hours remain watch-to-low absent verified one-way continuation. Conditional Tail rises around the 13:30 UTC cash open and peaks during the 14:00 UTC Richmond/Williams/Jefferson cluster; later risk narrows unless persistent near-extreme holding or failed retracements emerge.

forecast.analysis: Asian technology shares are advancing and a delayed NQ quote near 03:56 UTC was 30,880.50, up 0.31% and below a 30,916.50 session high. The evidence confirms firm risk appetite but does not establish repeated failed retracements or a persistent no-mean-reversion path.
drivers: Asian technology rally extends Monday's U.S. AI-led advance
Delayed NQ quote remains inside the overnight range, not at a verified one-way extreme
Lower Treasury yields offset part of the higher-for-longer policy pressure

news.title: Tech rally boosts Asian stocks, dollar firms on rate-hike wagers
Nasdaq notches record-high close, AI optimism reignites and Treasury yields retreat

forecast.analysis: If the Asian technology bid carries into the European handoff without accelerating into near-extreme holding, Tail should remain in WATCH rather than a block state. A new sequence of shallow pullbacks and repeated extensions would be the main upside Tail trigger.
drivers: European handoff tests whether Asia's technology strength broadens
Persistent shallow pullbacks would raise Tail; ordinary rotation would not

forecast.analysis: The European open should reduce Tail to low if price discovery becomes two-way. A directional gap-and-go sequence would invalidate that baseline, but the hour is not pre-scored as if such continuation has already occurred.
drivers: European cash open can either absorb or amplify the overnight technology bid
Two-way rotation is the low-Tail baseline

forecast.analysis: Absent a verified one-way European trend, the baseline is normal two-way price discovery with low Tail. Stress stays elevated because rates, oil and geopolitical headlines can still widen intraday ranges without implying mean-reversion failure.
drivers: European morning liquidity normally improves retracement opportunities
Oil and rate headlines remain volatility inputs rather than automatic Tail triggers

forecast.analysis: If European equities remain firm but NQ continues to retrace normally, Tail stays at WATCH. A synchronized technology surge with NQ holding near the hourly extreme would be the condition for a higher score.
drivers: Technology-sector follow-through is a conditional cross-asset amplifier
Meaningful NQ retracements would cap Tail despite positive breadth

forecast.analysis: The mid-European session remains a WATCH baseline. Tail would rise only if strength becomes directionally efficient across NQ, semiconductors and megacaps while pullbacks repeatedly fail; mixed rotation would leave the score unchanged or lower.
drivers: Mid-session European flow is expected to be less catalyst-dense
Cross-asset alignment matters only with confirming NQ price-path persistence

forecast.analysis: As U.S. participation begins to build, conditional Tail edges higher. The risk remains below the blocking threshold unless premarket NQ starts holding near extremes with shallow retracements and repeated extension.
drivers: U.S. premarket participation begins to increase
Near-extreme holding plus failed retracements is the key Tail escalation test

forecast.analysis: Premarket liquidity and positioning can increase directional efficiency, so Tail remains WATCH. A balanced range would keep the score contained; a persistent premarket trend into the cash open would raise the opening-hour risk.
drivers: Premarket positioning can transmit the prior technology rally
Balanced premarket rotation would limit opening-auction Tail

forecast.analysis: The final full premarket hour carries higher Stress ahead of the cash open and clustered Fed communication. Tail stays below 25% unless a one-way premarket path is actually established; event density alone does not create a block.
drivers: U.S. cash open approaches at 13:30 UTC
Fed-speaker and Richmond survey cluster follows in the next hour
Event density primarily raises Stress before outcomes and price response are observed

forecast.analysis: The 13:30 UTC cash open is a conditional danger window. Tail reaches elevated only if the opening auction produces persistent continuation, near-extreme holding or shallow failed pullbacks; ordinary opening volatility or a meaningful retracement would argue for rapid de-escalation.
drivers: 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open
Opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks is the principal Tail trigger
A meaningful early retracement would weaken the elevated scenario

forecast.analysis: This hour contains the 14:00 UTC Richmond survey, John Williams at 14:05 and Philip Jefferson at 14:20. Stress is extreme. Elevated Tail is conditional on an observed persistent directional response; the scheduled events themselves are not treated as proof of mean-reversion failure.
drivers: 14:00 UTC Richmond Fed regional business surveys
14:05 UTC John Williams remarks
14:20 UTC Philip Jefferson remarks
Persistent one-way post-event structure is required for elevated Tail

forecast.analysis: After the initial speaker sequence, Tail remains conditionally elevated only if NQ still holds near an extreme and retracements fail. Orderly two-way digestion, decaying volatility or a meaningful retracement would move the realized assessment back toward WATCH or low.
drivers: Post-speaker digestion can expose either continuation or normalization
Failed retracements would support a delayed second leg
Orderly two-way trade would rapidly reduce Tail

forecast.analysis: If the post-open session has developed normal pullbacks by this hour, Tail should fall back to WATCH. A renewed extension after a failed retracement would be the main reason for keeping risk elevated.
drivers: Midday normalization is the baseline after the early event cluster
Renewed extension after a failed retracement is the key upside Tail condition

forecast.analysis: Tom Barkin is scheduled to speak at 17:00 UTC with audience Q&A. Tail is conditionally elevated only if the remarks coincide with an already directional NQ path and failed retracements; otherwise the event mainly sustains Stress.
drivers: 17:00 UTC Tom Barkin speech and audience Q&A
Existing directional structure would determine whether the event amplifies Tail
Speaker importance alone primarily affects Stress

forecast.analysis: After the Barkin window, the baseline returns to WATCH if price discovery remains two-way. Persistent near-extreme holding or another failed retracement sequence would keep Tail higher than this forecast.
drivers: Post-speaker normalization is the base case
Near-extreme holding would invalidate the lower-Tail path

forecast.analysis: Power hour can amplify an established trend, so Tail conditionally reaches the blocking threshold. That score requires continued one-way structure into 19:00 UTC; if the afternoon has rotated normally, realized Tail should remain below this forecast.
drivers: 19:00-20:00 UTC U.S. power hour
Late-session continuation matters only if a directional structure is already established
Normal afternoon rotation would keep Tail below the blocking threshold

forecast.analysis: After the U.S. cash close, Tail should ease to WATCH if the session ends with meaningful rotation rather than a late one-way extension. Residual event or geopolitical headlines can keep Stress high without mechanically lifting Tail.
drivers: Post-cash-close liquidity transition
Late-session extension versus rotation determines residual Tail

forecast.analysis: CME equity-index futures have the daily 21:00-22:00 UTC maintenance interval in this hour. With continuous price discovery interrupted, path-based Tail is low; headline risk remains possible but cannot be scored as observed continuation during the halt.
drivers: 21:00-22:00 UTC CME Globex maintenance interval
Continuous NQ price-path evidence is unavailable during the maintenance break

forecast.analysis: At the 22:00 UTC Globex reopen, Tail returns to WATCH conditionally. An abnormal reopening gap followed by near-extreme holding and shallow pullbacks would raise risk; an orderly reopen with retracement would keep it contained.
drivers: 22:00 UTC Globex reopen
Reopening gap structure is the primary checkpoint
Orderly retracement would cap Tail

forecast.analysis: If the reopen is orderly and the market develops two-way overnight flow, Tail should return to low. A fresh one-way move driven by geopolitical or rate headlines would be the main invalidation.
drivers: Early Globex price discovery should reveal whether the reopen gap persists
Headline-driven directional repricing is the main upside Tail risk

forecast.analysis: The late-U.S. evening baseline is low Tail with lighter liquidity. Stress remains high enough to reflect headline sensitivity, but no future one-way path is assumed without evidence.
drivers: Late-evening liquidity is thinner but usually less catalyst-dense
No persistent future price path is assumed in advance

forecast.analysis: If overnight trading stays orderly, Tail remains low as Asia begins to engage. A synchronized technology move with NQ holding at an extreme would be required to move this hour materially higher.
drivers: Asian participation begins to increase
Synchronized technology strength would matter only with persistent NQ structure

forecast.analysis: The early Asian session remains low Tail under a two-way baseline. A renewed technology-led directional move could lift Stress and Tail, but only after its price-path persistence is observed.
drivers: Early Asian equity flow becomes a fresh cross-market checkpoint
Observed persistence, not expected direction, would govern any Tail increase

forecast.analysis: By the final forecast hour, Tail is WATCH if Asian technology follow-through remains a plausible catalyst. The score stays below a block absent verified shallow pullbacks, repeated extension or sustained near-extreme holding.
drivers: Asian technology follow-through remains a conditional overnight driver
Block-level Tail still requires observed mean-reversion failure

forecastDetail.comment: Firm Asian technology participation and a positive delayed NQ quote support WATCH, but no verified repeated failed-retracement sequence is established.
European handoff is the next test; ordinary rotation keeps Tail at WATCH, while persistent shallow pullbacks would raise it.
Low Tail assumes two-way price discovery around the European open; a verified gap-and-go sequence would invalidate that baseline.
Normal European morning rotation is the baseline; rates, oil and headlines can keep Stress elevated without proving mean-reversion failure.
WATCH reflects conditional technology follow-through risk; meaningful NQ retracements would prevent escalation.
Mid-European trade stays WATCH unless cross-asset strength is confirmed by persistent NQ extension and failed pullbacks.
